# Black Rabbit Creative

> A brand identity and packaging design studio in Portsmouth, New Hampshire.
> Black Rabbit Creative builds distinct, strategy-led brands for product-based
> businesses — breweries, food and beverage makers, retail and founder-led
> companies — across New England.

Founded and led by Danya Pugliese. The studio's position is that blending in
costs more than branding does: work begins with what a brand can credibly claim
that its competitors cannot, and carries that through identity, packaging and
every everyday touchpoint. Recognition includes a GDUSA Package Design Award for
craft beer label design.

## Services

- [Brand Identity Design](https://www.blackrabbit-creative.com/services/brand-identity): Positioning, voice, logo, typography, colour and brand guidelines as one system.
- [Logo Design](https://www.blackrabbit-creative.com/services/logo-design): Distinctive, precise marks with typography and usage guidelines.
- [Packaging Design](https://www.blackrabbit-creative.com/services/packaging-design): Production-ready packaging and labels for food, beverage and consumer goods.
- [Brewery Branding](https://www.blackrabbit-creative.com/services/brewery-branding): Taproom identity, can and label systems, merchandise and signage.
- [Graphic Design & Illustration](https://www.blackrabbit-creative.com/services/graphic-design): Campaign, print and social collateral plus custom illustration, extending an existing brand system.

Not offered: video production, broad marketing retainers outside design scope.

## Service area

Portsmouth and Keene, New Hampshire; and clients throughout New Hampshire,
Maine, Vermont, Massachusetts and Rhode Island.
